breakdown.description: The wall is labeled adiabatic (zero heat flux) but a fixed temperature boundary condition is simultaneously imposed on the same surface.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that applying both an adiabatic condition (no heat flux) and a fixed temperature condition to the same surface (x=0) is contradictory. It resolved this by creating a well-defined problem where the fixed temperature T(0)=350 K is at one boundary (x=0) and the adiabatic condition is at the other boundary. This is one of the valid solutions proposed by the ground truth.
